name: Threshold from 1 August 2023: five crore rupees

attrs.quote: with effect from the 1st day of August, 2023, for the words ―ten crore rupees‖, the words ―five crore rupees‖ shall be substituted
attrs.scope: registered persons whose aggregate turnover in any preceding financial year from 2017-18 onwards exceeds the threshold, for supplies to registered persons or for exports
attrs.note: The current threshold on 2026-11-01. Exclusions are in the exemption nodes.
